title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
abstract: arXiv:2610.21910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM

translated_title: CoWorld Reasoner：基于演化视频世界模型驱动框架的智能体多模态推理
translated_abstract: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）的不断发展，人们越来越期望它们能够对运动、动作和视角变化进行时空推理，超越输入图像所展示的内容。视频世界模型通过生成与任务相关的视觉内容作为额外证据，为视觉想象提供了一个自然的统一引擎。然而，现有方法通常通过以预定义的视觉想象形式（如新视角合成）为中心的固定流程来调用视频世界模型。为了支持面向多样化推理任务的灵活视觉想象，我们提出了CoWorld Reasoner，这是一个以视频世界模型作为统一视觉推理引擎的智能体框架。其视频世界模型驱动框架通过工具暴露多种视觉操作，并使用技能来引导VLM决定是否进行想象、选择操作、构建生成请求以及解释由此产生的视觉证据。我们进一步引入了VLM-VWM……
tldr: 该论文提出CoWorld Reasoner，一个以视频世界模型作为统一视觉推理引擎的智能体框架，通过工具与技能机制引导视觉语言模型灵活地决定是否想象、选择视觉操作并解读生成的视觉证据，从而支持多样化的多模态推理任务。
en_tdlr: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a Video World Model as a unified visual reasoning engine, where a tool- and skill-based harness guides VLMs to flexibly decide when and how to imagine and interpret generated visual evidence for diverse multimodal reasoning tasks.
